## Funding father of Workflow4Metabolomics

Gone way to early, Christophe was the main lead of Workflow4Metabolomics. 
That is putting it mildly to say that W4M could not have existed without him. 

You can find a tribute to his overall contribution to science [here](https://abims.sb-roscoff.fr/node/67).
